title: Textured Storybook
description: Une esthétique charmante dessinée à la main imitant des médiums secs comme le crayon de couleur, la craie grasse et la gouache sèche sur papier texturé. Présente une perspective orthographique plane, des hachures directionnelles irrégulières, des contours crayonnés et des blocs de couleurs vibrants avec des superpositions visibles.
prompt: Render a digital illustration mimicking traditional dry media, specifically colored pencil, wax crayon, and dry gouache on heavily toothed paper. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The image MUST occupy the absolute ENTIRE dedicated space as a canvas rule: NO borders, NO frames, NO white margins, NO canvas edges, FULL BLEED to all four corners. Utilize a flat, 2D orthographic perspective with shallow depth created purely through overlapping elements rather than linear perspective. Color logic is driven by vibrant, earthy blocks of {{primary_color}} and {{secondary_color}}, punctuated by energetic touches of {{accent_color}}. Avoid smooth gradients; instead, use visible scumbling and scratchy, directional shading where underlying paper textures and base colors peek through the strokes. Lighting is flat and illustrative, lacking harsh directional shadows or specular highlights, relying on local color values to define form. Edges must be jagged, rough, and hand-drawn, with imperfect color fills that occasionally bleed past or fall short of irregular, sketchy outlines. Use irregular, sketchy outlines in dark, earthy tones rather than pure black to define primary forms. The materiality must evoke a physical sketchbook page, complete with subtle paper grain and the friction of dry pigments dragged across a rough surface. The composition should feel meticulously arranged yet organically executed, with every shape possessing a handmade, slightly asymmetrical quality. Avoid any photorealistic rendering, glossy surfaces, or digital airbrushing. The visual rhythm is established by the chaotic but controlled energy of the visible pencil strokes and crayon marks. traditional media simulation, dry gouache, colored pencil, wax crayon, scumbling, children's book illustration, flat orthographic, heavily textured, full bleed, edge-to-edge, no border, no frame
background_prompt: A flat, illustrative background environment rendered in dry gouache and colored pencil on heavily toothed paper. The scene features layered, orthographic spatial arrangements using blocks of {{primary_color}} and {{secondary_color}} with {{accent_color}} highlights. Visible scumbling, scratchy directional shading, and a chalky texture dominate the surface. Flat lighting without harsh shadows creates a warm, whimsical atmosphere, entirely devoid of any central subjects or framing elements.
description_en: A charming, hand-drawn aesthetic mimicking dry media like colored pencil, wax crayon, and dry gouache on heavily textured paper. Features flat orthographic perspective, scratchy directional shading, irregular sketchy contours, and vibrant blocks of color with visible scumbling where underlying layers peek through.

video.motion: Subjects animate with a slight stop-motion or line-boiling effect, where the sketchy outlines and scumbled textures jitter slightly frame-to-frame, simulating hand-drawn frame-by-frame animation.
video.camera: Camera movements are strictly 2D pans and zooms, maintaining a flat orthographic perspective without any 3D parallax.
video.temporal_texture: The heavy paper grain remains static, while the scratchy directional shading and colored pencil strokes constantly redraw and boil to maintain a lively, handmade energy.
video.avoid: Avoid smooth tweening, motion blur, 3D camera rotations, realistic physics, and any stabilization of the hand-drawn line work.
